findingList.message: AC-07 is unmet: the fixture does not meet the specified case design, and both Fixtures/Evaluation/README.md and EvaluationCaseFixtureTests.V2ContentMeetsTheCaseDesign are missing.

evidence.codePathTraced: Each v2 case contains one document with a one-sentence pageText. The added fixture tests check that documents and text are nonempty, but do not implement the named V2ContentMeetsTheCaseDesign test; Fixtures/Evaluation/README.md is also absent from the diff.

reviewers.summary: The added tests cover several v2 fixture properties, but AC-07's case design requirements are neither present in the corpus nor verified by the named test.
